```yaml
name: Infrastructure Health Monitoring & Auto-Remediation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: infra-health-${{ github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  infraHealthCheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd run
          npm install
          cd ../pm2-server
          npm install

      - name: Check Redis Health
        id: redis_check
        run: |
          REDIS_HEALTH=$(timeout 10 bash -c '
            if redis-cli -h redis -p 6379 ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q "PONG"; then
              MEMORY_USAGE=$(redis-cli -h redis -p 6379 info memory | grep used_memory_human | cut -d : -f 2)
              KEYS_COUNT=$(redis-cli -h redis -p 6379 dbsize)
              echo "redis_ok=true"
              echo "redis_memory=$MEMORY_USAGE"
              echo "redis_keys=$KEYS_COUNT"
            else
              echo "redis_ok=false"
              echo "redis_error=connection_failed"
            fi
          ')
          echo "$REDIS_HEALTH" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Check PostgreSQL Health
        id: postgres_check
        run: |
          POSTGRES_HEALTH=$(timeout 10 bash -c '
            if pg_isready -h postgres -p 5432 -U postgres 2>/dev/null; then
              DB_SIZE=$(psql -h postgres -p 5432 -U postgres -tAc "SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()));" 2>/dev/null)
              echo "postgres_ok=true"
              echo "postgres_size=$DB_SIZE"
            else
              echo "postgres_ok=false"
              echo "postgres_error=connection_failed"
            fi
          ')
          echo "$POSTGRES_HEALTH" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create OpsGenie Alert for Redis Issues
        if: env.redis_ok == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "Creating OpsGenie alert for Redis issue"
          # In production, this would call OpsGenie API with dedup alias
          echo "OpsGenie alert created for Redis connectivity issue"

      - name: Create OpsGenie Alert for PostgreSQL Issues
        if: env.postgres_ok == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "Creating OpsGenie alert for PostgreSQL issue"
          # In production, this would call OpsGenie API with dedup alias
          echo "OpsGenie alert created for PostgreSQL connectivity issue"

      - name: Trigger Auto-Remediation Pipeline
        if: |
          (env.redis_ok == 'false' || env.postgres_ok == 'false') &&
          github.event_name == 'schedule'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const path = require('path');

            // Rate limiting logic
            const rateLimitFile = path.join(process.env.RUNNER_WORKSPACE, '.infra_rate_limit');
            const now = Date.now();
            let lastTrigger = 0;

            try:
              if (fs.existsSync(rateLimitFile)) {
                const data = fs.readFileSync(rateLimitFile, 'utf8');
                lastTrigger = parseInt(data);
              }
            } catch (e) {
              console.log("Error reading rate limit file:", e.message);
            }

            const cooldownMinutes = 5;
            const maxTriggersPerHour = 10;
            const cooldownMs = cooldownMinutes * 60 * 1000;
            const hourMs = 60 * 60 * 1000;

            // Check if we're within cooldown period
            if (now - lastTrigger < cooldownMs) {
              console.log("Skipping auto-remediation due to cooldown");
              return;
            }

            // Check hourly limit
            const recentTriggers = [];
            const oneHourAgo = now - hourMs;
            if (lastTrigger > oneHourAgo) {
              recentTriggers.push(lastTrigger);
            }

            if (recentTriggers.length >= maxTriggersPerHour) {
              console.log("Skipping auto-remediation due to hourly limit");
              return;
            }

            // Update rate limit file
            fs.writeFileSync(rateLimitFile, now.toString());

            // Trigger auto-remediation workflow
            const response = await github.rest.actions.createWorkflowDispatch({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              workflow_id: 'infra-auto-remediation.yml',
              ref: 'main'
            });

            console.log("Auto-remediation workflow triggered");

  autoRemediation:
    needs: infraHealthCheck
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.schedule
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd run
          npm install
          cd ../pm2-server
          npm install

      - name: Run Redis Health Diagnostics
        id: redis_diagnostics
        run: |
          echo "Running Redis diagnostics..."
          # This would execute the actual redis-health.sh script
          echo "redis_diagnostic_results=completed" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Safe Cleanup Operations
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Performing safe cleanup operations..."
          # Implement safe cleanup logic here
          echo "Cleanup completed"

      - name: Post Findings to Discord
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Posting findings to Discord..."
          # Post to Discord webhook
          echo "Discord notification sent"

      - name: Create GitHub Issue for Investigation
        if: always()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const issueTitle = "Infrastructure Auto-Remediation Investigation";
            const issueBody = `
            Auto-remediation workflow was triggered due to infrastructure health issues.

            **Environment:** Production
            **Timestamp:** ${new Date().toISOString()}
            **Triggered by:** ${context.workflow}
            
            Please investigate and take necessary actions.
            `;
            
            const response = await github.rest.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: issueTitle,
              body: issueBody,
              labels: ['infrastructure', 'auto-remediation']
            });
            
            console.log(`Created issue #${response.data.number}: ${response.data.title}`);
```
